about_the_game:
KAISA: Resurrection - Roadmap

KAISA commands you! Wishlist now!

After the sun sets and the clock strikes midnight, your task begins: you must feed your master before the first light of dawn. How hard can it possibly be to survive the night?


What happens during the day?... Well, that's another story.

Gameplay:

  • Feed your master during the night.

  • Scheme & Prepare during the day.

  • Find or order mighty weapons like REGULAR chopsticks or UNIMPRESSIVE kitchen knifes to improve your combat abilities.

  • Who knew lies could be a currency.

  • Stuff your master to turn back time.

  • Beware the noise you make, for that which listens will come..

  • Not everything is as it seems.

About us:

  • We’re a small, passionate two-man team that has been working hard for over 3 years to bring this game to life. 

    Artist: Handles the visual and gameplay side of things.

    Programmer: Makes it all run with code and… dark magic? (Artist's note.)

    Our Vision

  • Kaisa: Resurrection is ment to be a brutal but rewarding experience. A game that’s easy to pick up but demands real skill to master. It’s challenging, bloody, and unforgiving, but every victory is earned.

  • We love mystery and the unexpected, and weaving those elements into the game is a big part of our goal.

    A Quick Note

  • Kaisa: Resurrection is actively in development, and this is not a finished product. Features, balance, and mechanics will continue to evolve, and changes may come and go based on player feedback.

  • If you encounter a bug or have feedback, we’d love to hear from you! Drop by our Discord or Steam forum and let us know.
